title: Eternium Tools
description: A mod that adds new ore and tools
body:
Discover the Power of Eternium!
Add a fresh layer of adventure to your Minecraft world with Eternium Tools! This mod introduces a brand-new ore to mine, along with a full set of tools crafted from it. Dig, mine, and craft your way to new possibilities, whether you're exploring caves or gearing up for your next adventure.

Features:

A new, unique ore to find in your world.

Craftable tools with enhanced abilities and durability.

Seamlessly integrates with vanilla Minecraft for a smooth experience.

Perfect for players looking to expand their mining and crafting options without changing the core gameplay.

(this is my first mod so don't expect anything good from it)
